answer: Start from light client proof of Berachain state. Every identity must clear it before its first answer counts. A farm running 754 aliases would need 754 separate proofs, each costing about 89 POA or 15 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. One kernel of signal, one sonnet of cost, one pulse of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
